manual.check: engine media_encoder, start_now false: the item goes to Media Encoder's queue; preset, output path and the Render Queue status afterwards
manual.notes: Media Encoder 2026 queued it with its own last-used preset (QuickTime, Apple ProRes 4444), not the output module's H.264, so the output is in the same folder but ends .mov instead of .mp4. The Render Queue item read UNQUEUED right after the hand-over. After Effects stayed usable. The consent text and the result say this; start_now true also needs whole_ame_queue_ok because AME starts its whole queue. AME's render itself was not started (its queue held another item).
